title: Tin from a shore lot
body: After yesterday's lost sailing, the warehouse keeper is wary of promising goods still afloat. Awang Musa has a lot of Perak tin already ashore. He offers it by weight but won't wait for the treasury while the other buyers walk away. “This is my trade tin,” he says. “Don't count it among the king's tribute.”

choices.label: Weigh and buy the trade tin today
choices.outcome_text: The tin is weighed and the state pays the market price. The warehouse has its stock, though buyers who had hoped to take the tin abroad leave without it.

choices.label: Take half and leave half for private sale
choices.outcome_text: The state buys half at the market price. Awang sells the rest to the buyers who waited at the scales, but the warehouse keeper still has a shortage to cover.

choices.label: Let Awang sell the lot privately
choices.outcome_text: Awang sells while the buyers are still there. The treasury keeps its coin, but the warehouse keeper has to wait for another lot.
